features.title: Redact credentials before data reaches persistence
features.summary: Remove common credential shapes and caller-supplied secret literals while leaving ordinary code intact.
failureModes: Short literals are ignored to avoid over-redaction.
Credential-shaped text is removed before storage and indexing.

verification.testName: redacts caller-supplied literals and ignores too-short ones

features.title: Count, clip, and paginate UTF-8 text by bytes
features.summary: Measure and bound UTF-8 payloads without splitting a code point and with an explicit truncation marker.
failureModes: A multi-byte character is never split by byte clipping.
Pagination preserves the complete text without gaps.

verification.testName: counts bytes like a UTF-8 encoder
never splits a code point when clipping
paginates by bytes without losing text

features.title: Address complete nodes in a hierarchical memory tree
features.summary: Map level/index addresses to ranges, navigate relatives, identify complete nodes, and find the covering view node deterministically.
failureModes: Invalid addresses are rejected instead of mapped to a different node.
Incomplete nodes are never presented as complete summaries.

verification.testName: maps (level, idx) to the "start+len" covering range and back
only treats fully covered nodes as complete
finds the view node covering a position

features.title: Build deterministic bounded summaries and views
features.summary: Merge the most due node pairs first, preserve recent detail, retry summaries under a tighter byte budget, and report compatibility capabilities accurately.
failureModes: A summarizer answer that cannot fit is clipped deterministically or rejected if empty.
Full mode reports exactly which runtime hooks are missing.

verification.testName: retries a leaf with a stricter budget until the answer fits
reports exactly what full mode is missing
